data.name: Redshaw Valley
data.detailed_description:
Redshaw Valley is an RPG Adventure game that sees a group of friends race across time in an effort to thwart the evil mastermind Lotor. The story begins after the main characters best friend shows off her newest invention which goes wrong sending the group of friends into the future. This starts a chain of events taking the group of friends in an epic adventure to keep time from being re-written and restore it back to the way it was. Our main characters will earn experience and gather items to help them battle through the land wonderers and a few bosses along the way. As they gain experience they also gain gold which can be used to purchase items such as armour and weapons. The experience will also help you fight stronger and harder.

What makes Redshaw Valley unique is the mixture of Chibi style fully sized images of characters (not just the main ones either) and regular 2D playable characters. Add to that a great soundtrack and video animations and a good game becomes a great one. More and more unique features will be used in the future to bring this more to life and allow the player to feel the emotion behind what the characters are saying, rather than just reading the narrative.

Currently there is only the one game mode, however, it is planned to add a feature that allows a more choice based play once the main story is completed. The goal of the game, is for players to be thrown into the narrative and become part of the story. With the ability to play scenes from flashbacks adding a new dynamic to the way the story is told.

We hope you like the game and make sure you come visit us on our Discord page to give us some feed back.

data.short_description: Play along with the story on how a group of friends who unintentionally get sent to the future embark on a time-travelling journey to save the land known as Redshaw Valley. Collect items to be able to battle against enemies that roam the lands. Earn experience and collect gold along the way.
